html:
If you are a lover of peaceful spaces, away from the hustle and bustle, then the tourist attractions in the suburbs are the destination for you, let’s check out the attractions below with Vietlook.

Duong Lam Ancient Village, Hanoi suburbs

Located about 44km from Hanoi capital, Duong Lam Ancient Village is a destination for tourists who love to explore the beauty of the countryside, with its unique culture, enjoy the peaceful space, and return to ancient culture.

Bat Trang Pottery Village

Although located in the suburbs of Hanoi, this place brings its own beauty, when coming here, visitors will experience how to make pottery, create sophisticated products by hand, guided by artisans, which will bring visitors exciting feelings. In addition, visitors can visit the pottery market, the pottery museum and enjoy the attractive dishes of the local people.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village

Currently a famous virtual living spot that many tourists come to check in, and how to make incense bundles, not only that, the people here also decorate the incense bundles with beautiful images, visitors can take beautiful pictures from any angle, visitors can take beautiful pictures next to the scenery of Quang Phu Cau incense village.

Co Loa Citadel

Located in Dong Anh, Hanoi, about 20km, Co Loa Citadel is a destination with important historical value that attracts tourists to visit, learn about the culture, listen to thrilling stories. There is An Duong Vuong temple, Ngoc Well relic, Ba Chua Am relic, Cao Lo temple, … which preserves precious cultural and historical values ​​and is an indispensable sightseeing spot in the Hanoi tour itinerary.

Gióng Temple

A spiritual tourist destination that many tourists visit when they have the opportunity to set foot in Hanoi, especially in early spring, visitors come here to visit and worship to pray for a healthy and peaceful new year. Coming to Gióng Temple, visitors visit Trinh Temple, Mau Temple, Dai Bi Pagoda, Thuong Temple, Saint Gióng Monument…

Hung Temple

An indispensable destination in the journey to Hanoi, especially on the anniversary of the death of the ancestors, visitors can offer incense to express their respect, and admire the scenery here.

In addition, visitors also visit the resorts on the outskirts of Hanoi, the resorts are designed to be very close to nature, with airy space, especially when traveling to Thien Son Suoi Nga in October, visitors can also immerse themselves in the beauty of wild sunflowers in bloom.

Ba Vi National Park

A destination for tourists who love peace and wild scenery, especially tourists traveling to Ba Vi in groups can experience overnight camping, and participate in interesting family activities that will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

Huong Tram Ecological Area

Coming here, visitors will not only immerse themselves in nature, admire the magical shimmering scenery, and participate in interesting entertainment programs such as fishing, outdoor BBQ, visitors will have the most enjoyable vacation.

Lynn Times Thanh Thuy

A popular resort for many tourists, coming here visitors will be able to visit and immerse themselves in the natural hot mineral springs, with enthusiastic and professional service that will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.
